route-server-route-maps-extra-charge.title: Route maps are a preview feature with extra charges
route-server-route-maps-extra-charge.body: This estimate turns on route maps, which Microsoft says is in preview and carries extra charges, so confirm the customer needs them.

citation.source: About route maps for Azure Route Server
citation.quote: Using route maps incurs extra charges.

route-server-single-nva-peer.title: Peer at least two NVA instances with Route Server
route-server-single-nva-peer.body: This estimate has a single NVA peering with Route Server. Microsoft recommends peering at least two NVA instances with both Route Server instances so routing survives a failure; price a second one if the customer wants that.

citation.quote: We also recommend that you peer at least two NVA instances with both instances of Route Server.
